_comment_: Path-A run config: receipts come from a Zoho Expense CSV export (BLUEPRINT 8.1) instead of the generic extracted-fields CSV. Copy to runs/<month>.json and edit. Paths resolve relative to THIS file's directory.

receipts._: Path-A receipt source. The Zoho Expense export is column-map driven, so the tool hardcodes no Zoho header names.
receipts._column_map_help: Logical field -> Zoho Expense export column header. Required keys: expense_date, amount, vendor. Optional: currency, document_id, reference, report_number, receipt_url, receipt_name, payment_mode, paid_through, category, exchange_rate, amount_base, reimbursable, location. A mapped-but-absent optional column is skipped, not an error. CONFIRM header names against a real Zoho Expense export before a production run; the names below are a documented-format template, not a verified header.
receipts._receipt_fork_help: The receipt-URL design fork (8.1): map receipt_url when the export carries a stable URL; map receipt_name when it only carries the attachment filename (8.4 receipt-URL hosting resolves the filename to a URL by matching the receipts folder). Mapping both is fine; each row uses whichever it has.
receipts._default_currency_help: Applied to expense rows whose mapped currency column is blank.

_store_help: Optional (BLUEPRINT 8.2/8.3). Persist the tool's own tables so a run's statement + reports survive the Zoho switch-off. Omit the block to skip; each path is independently optional. statement_id defaults to '{account_id}:{first_date}..{last_date}' so a re-run of the same month matches and a revised charge surfaces as a conflict.
_hosting_help: Optional (BLUEPRINT 8.4). Content-address filename-only receipts and resolve each to a stable URL the Books export carries (8.5). root is the store directory; receipts_dir is the folder the receipt_name files live in; url_template defaults to the host-agnostic '/receipts/{relpath}' (the Chris-local-vs-host run-target is the deferred 5c decision).
